limits: Undamped one-pole fit to the 1500–1600 nm public samples, diagonal Yee coefficients, fixed impressed carrier mode and five frequency-specific port bases. Frequency margins are diagnostic only. Loss separation assumes equal buses.

field_preview.description: Instantaneous Ey electric field at z = 0 µm

loaded_loss.model: Symmetric single travelling resonance. Two through/drop bus rates are assumed equal, and all remaining linewidth is apparent internal loss. Independent decaying field probes and the earlier 80% of the record gate the estimate. Absolute internal Q is withheld for a loss fraction comparable to the power-fit residual.

vendor_comparison.resonance_scope: Nearest unshifted peak within half a published free spectral range. This assignment does not prove the same angular order. Reference half-height Q requires one peak and at least four source samples across its FWHM.

validation_scope: One physical port launch and its matched unpatterned two-bus reference. Checking the complete output spectrum uses all 241 illuminated bins; partial spectra preserve each wavelength mask.
